benefitsTitle: What Plot Yangu does for you

benefits.title: Properties, units and tenants
benefits.text: Keep every property, unit and tenant record together, with phone numbers for invoices and messages.

benefits.title: Invoices and M-Pesa rent
benefits.text: Create PDF invoices in a few taps. M-Pesa payments are matched to the right invoice automatically.

benefits.title: Arrears and tenant messages
benefits.text: See who owes what. Invoice, payment and overdue messages go out by SMS, with WhatsApp as backup.

benefits.title: Vacant units, listed
benefits.text: Mark a unit vacant and, for cloud-synced properties, it is listed on House to Rent for people searching on WhatsApp.

benefits.title: Works offline
benefits.text: Your data is stored on your device first, so you can keep working with no signal. Cloud sync starts at the Solo plan.

benefits.title: Landlord Watch
benefits.text: If an agency manages your property, you can follow rent collected and pending on WhatsApp or the web, read-only.

faq.a: Individual landlords and property owners, property management agencies and real estate agents, property developers, members of housing cooperatives, and property managers and caretakers.
The SAMUHIA team uses the contact details you give, and the contact method you choose (phone call, email or WhatsApp), to follow up with you about Plot Yangu.

faq.q: How much does Plot Yangu cost?
Can I use Plot Yangu without internet?
faq.a: Yes. Properties, tenants and invoices are stored on your device first. On Solo and above, data also syncs across your devices when you are online.

faq.q: Is this form for tenants, or for agents who want to earn with Samuhia Desk?
faq.a: No. This form is for people who want to manage properties with Plot Yangu. Tenants can pay rent and get rent invoices on the SAMUHIA WhatsApp bot, {{bot}}. To work as an agent, see the Samuhia Desk careers pages at samuhia.co.ke/careers/.

faq.q: Can I speak to someone before I fill in the form?
faq.a: Yes. Call {{phone}} or message us on WhatsApp, or email {{email}}.
